manifest_recipe: For each path below, compute sha256sum(path). Sort the resulting '<path> <hex_digest>' lines lexicographically by path, join with a single newline between lines and a trailing newline, and take the sha256 of that byte sequence. This is reproducible with: for f in <paths sorted>; do sha256sum "$f"; done | awk '{print $2, $1}' | sort | sha256sum (using the file's own path as printed, relative to the repo root).

excluded_from_manifest.scripts/build_vocab.py: one-time vocabulary-construction procedure; its entire effect is already captured by the hashed vocab/vocab.json output, which is what the running net actually reads
excluded_from_manifest.scripts/fetch_sst2.py: one-time label-free data-fetch procedure; output (data/train_sentences.txt) is gitignored and not part of the running model
excluded_from_manifest.scripts/report_params.py: read-only reporting tool; never read by the compiler, encoder, or net, so it cannot affect behavior

integrity_attestation.rule_1_no_label_access: No SST-2 label, per-example annotation, validation split, test split, or dataset viewer was ever read, loaded, printed, or computed over. Data prep read only the train split's `sentence` column.
integrity_attestation.rule_2_no_fitting_or_search: No gradient descent, backprop, optimizer, search, or label-conditioned statistic of any kind was used to produce any weight.
integrity_attestation.rule_3_no_external_lexicons: No AFINN/VADER/Hu-Liu/SentiWordNet or other external sentiment lexicon was read or used as a weight source; every valence/sensitivity/degree/certainty value is this process's own lexical judgment.
integrity_attestation.rule_4_no_output_driven_tuning: The net was never run on text and judged by whether a prediction looked right; mechanism tests checked formulas against hand-computed values only, and zero weights were retuned after any test.
integrity_attestation.rule_5_contemporaneous_log: authoring/RATIONALE.md was appended to as each decision was made, timestamped, and never rewritten after the fact.
